objective: A resumable prediction and post-delivery feedback entry point for a fixed policy, a once-selected policy, a continuing selector and a recent-feedback comparator. Score actual accepted outputs. Decide whether switching is worth including. Freeze before downloading or scoring UCI 322.
sources: Both 12-hour UCI 322 mixture runs, within each original file in time order. Binary objective: ethylene present iff its set point exceeds zero. A physical example is a nonoverlapping 10-second interval on the original elapsed clock; the feature vector is the mean of all 16 sensor readings in that interval, the target is the prevailing label by number of readings (ties count as absent). Both labels on a boundary interval are retained as a single majority target; no filtering by purity or confidence. Zero-based consecutive 600-second windows form real service batches. No timestamp, set point, co-gas or ID in predictive features. Train on the entire other file's prepared, disjoint windows, test all windows of the opposite background. Each direction is an independent cold start, not two independent physical instruments. One returned batch only after its acceptance; take up to 32 true labels by digest([17,ID]); none after final acceptance.
tools: Common frozen library: (1) source-only shrinkage linear discriminant; (2) the existing confusion-calibrated source expert bank; (3) source plus all previously returned rows in a class-balanced logistic model, total weight equal for source and target; (4) latest returned batch single random-forest tree seed 0, falling back to observer before first return. Independent hardware source expert bank: seeded source single tree 0, balanced logistic seed17, balanced 100-tree forest depth 6 seed17, same shrinkage discriminant, balanced RBF SVM source-standardized. Official source bank and evolving current industrial checkpoint are the original gas delivery implementation. On official scores include the deployed observer, the old predictions and the one-candidate Self-Healing adaptation with the same calibration using audited source runs.
decisions: Cold start is observer for all selective modes. Use a tool's prediction on each feedback case from before its label arrived. Once: after the first returned batch select the tool with the best accumulated Macro-F1; on a tie preserve incumbent. Continue: recompute this rule every batch. Recent: same procedure ranking on only the latest returned batch, closed-menu backtest comparator, not original H-LLM. For switching, alternative must exceed incumbent by at least 0.01 (all modes). Use all configured classes when computing Macro-F1, zero for an absent class. Order for ties is observer, source LDA, mixed logistic, latest tree. Include fixed versions of all four tools plus all source classifiers and fixed majority directly. Same label cap and proposal/fit ceilings; count required fits separately, instrument shared computation and compare resources honestly.
official: Official gas: same ten service batches/returned explore+adopt IDs as the current integrated run, seed17, budget32, consume previous batches only. Verify per-item observer and same-feedback logistic against prior stored results. Compare actual resumption and single-row inference from the deployed snapshots. In external transfer benchmark system and fixed comparators use the same simulator and actual accepted payloads. Predictions before disclosure; source and observed records verified by identity. Single-run measured wall/CPU costs, no paid model or platform calls.
decision: Require per-stream >=0.01 Macro-F1 versus all fixed selectable tools, strong static source predictors and choose-once, and worst true-class recall no more than 0.02 below strongest fixed tool. Record changed/rescued/spoiled predictions vs once; inspect per ten-minute block. Only select for default upon official and both fresh streams passing. Otherwise keep old default, diagnose once whether selector headroom exists; prequential service performance and paid/fit cost, not hindsight picking, determine deployment.
